verdict.rationale: n8n documents a public REST API (n8n-docs-16) that developers could build against, but there is no evidence of dedicated, officially maintained SDK packages (e.g., Python/Node client libraries) or SDK-specific quickstart docs — the API reference is the only artifact resembling programmatic access. missing for 10: official language SDKs (Python/JS/Go), SDK reference docs, SDK usage examples, and independent confirmation of SDK adoption.
